Massive poured-in-place concrete water tower with crenellated sides. One
story hipped roof pump house.

L-shaped brick shopping center, now used primarily for auto mech. Open
bays for truck & trailer parts w/vertical window panes & mansard roof.

One story hipped roof brick veneer dwelling with attached garage on front
and recessed front porch.

Public square w/ central flag pole & benches to central aisle, various
public monuments, & fountain on west side w/ faux historic lighting.
Parking lot with three brick entry pylons and metal 4' fence.

One story concrete and brick commercial building with aluminum
storefront and five bay garage wing.
One story brick veneer office building with box awning around perimeter.
One story metal building with three bay garage and CMU rear wall.
Parking lot with hipped roof building at rear.
Asphalt parking lot with basketball goal.
Vacant lot with steps to what was likely a former residence.

One story CMU garage attached to 300 S. Palace Avenue/Dealers Supply
Company.

Hipped roof dwelling with arched metal windows and brick/stone accents.
Projecting gable garage.
